contract: Add a whole-parent skip only when both exact Q25 partitions fully cover the parents, both parent triangles are exact common translations that remain in horizontal XY planes, projected parent vertices match exactly at start and finish under one permutation, and each same-ID patch cell has the same projected trajectory. This proves only same-footprint normal-only relative motion; all other cases use ordinary CCD.

limitations: Axis-aligned XY parent planes only; no arbitrary orientation, rotation, tangential slip, shear, deformation, or cross-wired patch mapping.
This proves projected domain correspondence for exactly represented trajectories, not a full physical mortar/contact qualification.
FP32 barycentric evaluation that cannot preserve the exact common projected sweep fails closed to ordinary CCD.
